_comment: GLINTWOLD - the faceted world. A walk-and-wonder world that looks like a low-poly scene seen from above: everything is flat triangles, each a single clean colour by how it faces a light that is still slowly turning. It was CUT, not grown. Nine regions: the Landing (where you arrive), the Heart (the Turning Floor and the Unfinished), the Tines, the Pinefold, Goldhanger, the Low Tarns, the Brokeback, Cutwater (the lake) and the Shardfield. Its 'art' block is pokepals/tools/lowpoly/glintwold_art.json and glintwold_look.json deep-merged over a small fallback (ground.render 'facet', actor_look.facet). Tree kinds: tree, great_tree, gw_round, gw_spire, gw_hill, gw_boulder. The 'heartstone' block places the Unfinished, its two marks and the Turning Floor; the secret (reveal type 'facets') is the offcut. Generated by tools/gen_glintwold_world.py - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Everything here was cut, not grown, and the light that cut it is still turning. Watch the faces change. In the middle, something was left unfinished.

props.label: a cut-stone sign
props.lore: GLINTWOLD, says the sign, cut into one clean face of stone. Underneath, smaller: "Mind the light. It's still working."

props.label: a bench looking north
props.lore: From this bench you can just see the Unfinished, far up the path, catching the light in pieces.

props.label: a cairn of flat stones
props.lore: Flat stones stacked by someone who liked flat stones. Here, that's everyone.

props.label: an old story-cairn
props.lore: Scratched on the top stone: "Once the whole wold was one dull stone, lying in the dark. Then a light found it, and began, very slowly, to turn round it. Wherever it touched, a face was cut."

props.label: a carved plinth
props.lore: Carved into the plinth in small, careful letters: "It only looks whole from two places at once."

props.label: a sign at the floor's edge
props.lore: THE UNFINISHED. The cutting stopped one face short, and here it hangs, in pieces that won't sit still. They drift apart when nobody's looking, and a little when somebody is.

props.label: a bench facing the stone
props.lore: Folk sit here to watch the Unfinished turn its pieces in the light. It never quite closes. Not on its own.

props.label: a bench by the water
props.lore: The lake holds the sky in bands, like a stack of coloured glass. Every so often one face of it flashes white, and then a different one.

props.label: a sign by the shore
props.lore: CUTWATER. The water was cut too, they say, the same as everything. That's why the little waves come in dead straight.

props.label: a cairn among the spires
props.lore: Up among the spires the air rings, very faintly, as the light turns. Folk came up here to listen, and left a stone each.

props.label: a gem cluster
props.lore: A cluster of gems no bigger than your fist. Each flat face is a glint. This one has more glints than anyone has ever bothered to count.

props.label: a sign under the pines
props.lore: THE PINEFOLD. Every pine here was cut in one go, top to toe, in the time it takes the light to cross a hand.

props.label: a cairn by the great pine
props.lore: The great pine was one of the first things the light cut, after the hills. It took longer than the rest. You can tell: it has more faces.

props.label: a bench under round trees
props.lore: The round trees here catch the light low and hold on to it. Gold on one side, rose on the other, and both change while you watch.

props.label: a sign between the hills
props.lore: THE BROKEBACK. Hills with their corners left on. Walk round behind one and the whole wold goes quiet for a step or two.

props.label: a cairn in the shards
props.lore: Loose shards everywhere, the bits the light trimmed off. Nobody sweeps them up. They're good luck, and they catch the evening.

props.label: a bench between the tarns
props.lore: Two small tarns, so still they keep whole faces of the sky. Lean over and you're cut into faces too, a little.

props.label: a low stone arch
props.lore: A stone arch cut from three blocks. Step through it and the light on your shoulders changes colour, just slightly.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (issue #160). reveal.type 'facets': the Unfinished (the 'heartstone' block) hangs in pieces; half answer to where the player stands, half to where the companion stands, and each half slides home only when its viewer stands on its own mark ('heartstone.marks', within 'tolerance'). Both home and held 'hold_s': the stone closes and the offcut falls at 'position'. Any actor on a mark counts, so two friends can close it too. It all happens on the players' screens, so the server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A chip of stone no bigger than your thumb, with one face cut perfectly flat. It's the last face, the one that had to come away so the rest could close. It catches the light from every side at once.

lines.notice: Your companion stops and looks across the Turning Floor, at one particular spot, as if it can see the stone from there.
lines.stand: Your companion stands where you showed it, and looks up at the stone.
lines.go_look: Your companion trots round the Turning Floor, looking up at the stone, and settles somewhere on the far side.
lines.closing: The pieces slide together. Hold still.

reveal.reveal_line: The pieces close with a flash, and for a moment the Unfinished is whole. Light runs over every face. Something small and bright drops at its foot.

secret.found_line: The stone was always one face short. Now you have the face, and it looks whole from wherever it likes.

keepsake.label: the offcut, on a little stand
keepsake.line: A small faceted chip that catches the light. Your companion walks round it slowly, as if it might close up if seen from the right place.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
